newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board in moderate trade on some late buying interest in line with firmer Japanese prices, dealers said on Friday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly on technically-driven buying supported by the yen's slight weakening against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh incentives, but prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon as some speculative buying emerged in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 rose two cents to 121.25 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 rose half a cent to 169.50 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
July/September TSR20 rose half a cent to 167.50 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg.
